entities.name: HIV-1 Nef
observations: A 205-aa query matched reviewed HIV-1 Nef references at 84.5–85.0% identity, 100% query coverage, with E-values 1.66e-140 to 2.43e-139.
Curated Nef annotations describe immune evasion, downregulation of host CD4 and MHC molecules, and support of viral infectivity/replication.
Annotated localization includes the host-cell inner plasma membrane and Golgi/TGN membranes; Nef can also occur in virions and extracellular material.
Pfam scan detected the HIV F-protein domain (PF00469) across residues 2–204; function assignment is supported by strong homology rather than direct assay of this query.
